notes.title: Big updates coming!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey guys, Kevin here! [/h2]
I’m here to say that the game isn’t dead! I started a big project for it. I’ve decided to re-work everything. The game will be reworked from the ground up!

[b]Currently working on changing:[/b]

[list]
[*] The story (will be more understandable)
[*] The name! (It won’t be called freakshow 2, it will have name that fits)
[*] Gameplay (redoing all the base mechanics, even added some new ones! Exemple: an inventory)
[*] Achievements (because it’s no longer the same game, new achievements!) sorry achievements hunters that already collected everything!
[*] And more!
[/list]

Currently I’m working on getting it done sometime[i] late next year.[/i] (I’m a one man team) But I might stream my progress (Game dev streams)

Also the name change and new logos will be next year when I’m close to being done! 

Sorry for the lack of updates in the past months, kinda been all over the place with my studies! But I wanted to finish the game and make it worth your time! (The game was in early access!) but thank you for playing the early version and sticking with me till now!

Also, what will happen with the one here (the original game) on steam? Most likely I’ll remove it when I put up the new version and upload the old one on the side or different site! (It’s part of history!)

[u]Tell me what you guys think in the comments and thank you again for the support!
[/u]

-KevinTheWolfy!

notes.title: Update 1 Official post
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1 Official post[/h1]

Welcome to the first official post for Early access! What will be inside the early access edition? There is currently 8 playable mini games! Achievements! Gifts you can buy inside the game shop! And there is more to come in future updates!

Early access will be coming soon! (I’m waiting for approval) but I’m hoping to get it out by April 25th! Then there will be updates every month hopefully, it should add new content for you all to play!


What will be coming in future update!

- balance the tokens (kinda unfair atm)
- More use for the the tokens, (you can buy 4 items from the shop, then you unlock a mode to waste them,)
- Add a game mode that used the freaks in a survival fashion.
- A in-game music tab? (Idk yet)
- Add music to the mini games! (2/5)
- Make a demo to story mode? (Maybe a game mechanic show off?)
- A prize for wasting tokens
- Developer commentary! (Eventually)
- Fix loading screen issues
-Add some details (idk exactly yet)
-Add the Gamejolt API?
-Add the Steam API?
-More to come! 

Thank you guys for all the support! I’ll see you all in the next post! :)

-KevinTheWolfy 

P.s: Don’t forget, Bork!
